title: Rupee equivalents of World Bank poverty lines, 2021 PPP
sourceIndicatorId: World Bank 2021 PPP line update; PA.NUS.PRVT.PP

metadata.provenance: World Bank global poverty-line update and India household consumption PPP conversion factor for 2021.
metadata.method: Approximate rupee equivalents use India's 2021 household final consumption PPP conversion factor of about Rs 19.47 per international dollar, rounded to whole rupees.
metadata.caveat: These are 2021 PPP rupees, not market exchange-rate rupees and not current-price Indian poverty lines.
